value.rationale: All partial Latin squares of order three are a canonical finite partial-assignment complex, with genuine incomplete maximal configurations of sizes five and seven alongside 12 complete size-nine Latin squares. Discovering a concentrated integral homotopy wedge in degree four for this eight-dimensional nonpure complex supplies a natural exact benchmark for higher-order completion-space topology, rather than an arbitrary subinstance or routine numerical correction.
